title: fagraea cochinchinensis
intro: Fagraea cochinchinensis, commonly known as the Frangipani of the forest, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and displaying antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Fagraea cochinchinensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Fagraea cochinchinensis have been identified to include flavonoids such as kaempferol and quercetin, as well as alkaloids like gentianine and gentianidine.
